statements.statement: The journal's editors published an expression of concern about the paper because they have been made aware of concerns about some of the data.
The matter is still being looked into, and the editors will update readers when more information is available.
The notice does not say which data, figures or results the concerns are about, while the paper's data include immobility times (Figure 3) and bacterial counts (Figure 4).
The paper's main finding is that transplanting gut bacteria from depressed donors made recipient mice less active in a forced-swim test (Figure 3).
In the Discussion, the draft cites Lopez and Chen [8] as having shown reduced activity in recipient mice, as support for a causal role, and says its own proposal builds on this finding.
